script.title: Why Tata Motors Lost ₹5,531 Crore #shorts

segments.text: Tata sold more cars, yet lost 5,500 crore rupees. Revenue jumped 34%, but profits completely vanished.
Every Indian road is packed with Nexons and Punches. So where did all that customer cash go?
First, the brutal EV price war. Tata rolled out heavy discounts to protect its market share from aggressive rivals.
Second, gigantic investments into next-generation battery platforms and factory tooling crushed their quarterly margins.
In the auto industry, selling more metal at deep discounts turns surging revenue into red ink.
Showrooms were packed, but discounts burned the bottom line. That is the exact reason why...

script.description: Tata's passenger vehicle sales jumped 34%, yet the unit reported a ₹5,531 crore loss. Here is how aggressive EV price cuts and heavy plant investments flipped their margins upside down. Educational breakdown, not financial advice. #TataMotors #IndianBusiness #PaisaDecoded
